```{r}
library(MASS)
library(glmnet)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
source("Negative_binomial_regression.R")
```

```{r}
set.seed(1028)

NegBin_data_generete <- function(X, true_coefficient, y_rate = 1){
  
  n_X <- nrow(X)
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  beta_true <- true_coefficient
  
  eta <- as.matrix(X) %*% as.matrix(beta_true)
  Y_mean <- exp(eta)
  
  # Generate Y values according to Y_mean (fixing rate, scale = 1/rate)
  
  rate <- y_rate
  Y_shape <- Y_mean/rate
  Y <- rnbinom(n_X, mu = Y_mean, size = 8)
  
  sim_data <- cbind(Y, X)

  return(sim_data)
}

# Example

n <- 5000 


x1 <- runif(n = n, min = 0, max = 2)
x2 <- rexp(n = n, rate = 1)
x3 <- rbinom(n = n, size = 3, prob = 0.1)
x3 <- as.numeric(x3)
beta <- c(0.3, 0.1, 0.2)

X <- data.frame(
  "X1" <- x1,
  "X2" <- x2,
  "X3" <- x3
)

simulation_data <- NegBin_data_generete(X, true_coefficient = beta)

colnames(simulation_data) <- c("Y", "X1", "X2", "X3")

simulation_data <- as.data.frame(simulation_data)
```

```{r}
glm.nb(Y~X1 + X2 + X3, data = as.data.frame(simulation_data))


NB_u_sim_optim = NB_dual_optim(Y = simulation_data$Y, gram_mat = as.matrix(X) %*% t(as.matrix(X)), lambda = 0.02, r = 8)$u
coef_recover(XTu = t(as.matrix(X)) %*% NB_u_sim_optim, u = NB_u_sim_optim, lambda = 0.02)

NB_r_MoM(Y = simulation_data$Y, gram_mat = as.matrix(X) %*% t(as.matrix(X)), gamma = NB_u_sim_optim, lambda = 0.02)
```


```{r}
NegBin_data_generete_new <- function(X, true_coefficient,
                                 r_true = 6){

  n_X <- nrow(X)
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  beta_true <- as.matrix(true_coefficient)

  ## True linear predictor and mean
  eta <- X %*% beta_true
  Y_mean <- as.vector(exp(eta))

  ## Generate Negative Binomial response
  Y <- rnbinom(n_X,
               mu = Y_mean,
               size = r_true)

  ## Oracle MoM estimate of r
  numerator <- sum(Y_mean^2)
  denominator <- sum((Y - Y_mean)^2 - Y_mean)

  if (denominator > 0) {
    r_MoM_oracle <- numerator / denominator
  } else {
    r_MoM_oracle <- Inf
  }

  sim_data <- cbind(Y, X)

  return(list(
    sim_data = sim_data,
    Y = Y,
    mu_true = Y_mean,
    beta_true = beta_true,
    r_true = r_true,
    r_MoM_oracle = r_MoM_oracle
  ))
}

```

```{r}

simulation_new = NegBin_data_generete_new(X = X, true_coefficient = beta)

simulation_data = simulation_new$sim_data

alternating_fit = NB_alternating_optim(Y = simulation_data[,1], gram_mat = as.matrix(X) %*% t(as.matrix(X)), r_init = 7 , lambda = 0.02, max_iter = 20)

alternating_fit$history

coef_recover(XTu = t(as.matrix(X)) %*% alternating_fit$u, u = alternating_fit$u, lambda = 0.02)

glmd_fit = glm.nb(Y~X1 + X2 + X3, data = as.data.frame(simulation_data))
glmd_fit$theta
```
